title: Connect the academy with weekly planning and Agent Studio
summary: Adds eight destination shortcuts, assessment-based weekly sessions, optional onboarding preferences and an executable offline agent workshop while preserving existing learning data.

changes.detail: Eight academy destinations, seven flexible sessions prioritizing due recall, and a bounded agent tool runner with observable trace and failure checks.
Onboarding supports skipping and optional interests, routine goals and accessibility notes. Existing profile shape remains readable.
Home, progress and search connect to the new screens. Existing lessons, consoles, authentication and wellness storage are preserved.

validation.name: Implementation checks
validation.detail: Typecheck, lint, regression and interaction checks pending. No deployment, device build or live AI verification performed.
